tagline: API collections, specs, and environments for remote teammates — edits need your approval.
requirements: Set POSTMAN_API_KEY in the host environment. The local server starts with Postman's minimal toolset (42 tools); this guide documents the most relevant ones. Flags such as --code, --full, and --region eu are not part of this catalog's launch.

tools.name: getAuthenticatedUser
tools.note: Identifies the account behind the API key.

tools.name: getWorkspaces
tools.note: Lists workspaces the key can access.

tools.name: getCollection
tools.note: Reads collection contents, including request examples.

tools.name: getEnvironments
tools.note: Lists environments. Values may include secrets — review before sharing.

tools.name: getEnvironment
tools.note: Reads environment variables. Values may include secrets — review before sharing.

tools.name: getEnabledTools
tools.note: Lists the tools this server exposes.

tools.name: runCollection
tools.note: Executes collection requests against your APIs — real calls, including any that write.

tools.name: duplicateCollection
tools.note: Copies a collection under your identity.

seo.description: Share the official Postman MCP server with MCPWire. Configure an API key on the host, let teammates read collections and specs over P2P, and keep collection writes behind approval.
